items.title: 68728_Jonah
items.q: his name was Raymond Tate. He was alto, played the alto horn too

ctx.x: And that was something new to me, you know, because as a kid you're always looking for new things. But then we had another little cat in there, his name was Raymond Tate. He was alto, played the alto horn too, and he went around and hitting on the tents with a stick, you know. Well, there was a saxophone player, sitting on the side of his bunk there, and he hit him in the head, and he fell out, you know, the guy passed out. So these kinds of things were always jumping up, you know. And they raised the devil at him.
Well, Mrs. Allen wouldn't go on the trips, or would she?
